name: todoist
description: Todoist workflow skills for agents: capture well-formed tasks, triage the Inbox, walk the overdue pile, prune stale ideas, reconcile the board against memory, and review the project tree - all against the user's own conventions, with a generic default.

interface.shortDescription: Todoist capture, inbox triage, idea pruning, board reconcile, and structural review.
interface.longDescription: Todoist workflow skills that share one conventions-loading rule: each run uses the user's own Todoist conventions (from a connected memory tool, else ~/.config/todoist-skills/conventions.md), falling back to a shipped generic default. add (capture one well-formed task, errand, or idea), triage (empty the Inbox, then walk the overdue pile), prune (propose ideas untouched 90+ days for deletion, recording each first), structural-review (audit the project and section tree), reconcile (audit the board against memory, then decide findings in small rounds), and full-review (run triage, prune, reconcile, and structural-review in one sitting).
